Scorpion valvetrain stabilizers, often referred to as stud girdles, are high-quality valvetrain stabilizers that are CNC-machined from 6061-T6 aluminum to give you a precise fit with minimum weight. They're designed to eliminate the rocker stud flexing and associated horsepower loss that results from high-lift cams and high-pressure valve springs.
